x-groups.title: Change data capture
x-groups.description: Only for tables read with cdc.

dsn.description: A URL, oracle://USER:PASSWORD@HOST:PORT/SERVICE, naming the pluggable database's service, such as FREEPDB1; the port is 1521 if it's left empty, as HOST:/SERVICE. Options go in its query: TLS with ?SSL=true, verifying the server's certificate unless SSL VERIFY=false, and a wallet with WALLET=/path/to/wallet; CONNECTION TIMEOUT=SECONDS bounds a connection's setup.
dsn.title: Connection URL

schema.description: The schema whose tables are offered as streams, as Oracle stores its name, usually in upper case. Default: the user's current schema, its own unless a logon trigger sets another.
schema.title: Schema

tables.description: The tables to offer as streams, as Oracle stores their names, usually in upper case. Empty: every table in the schema.
tables.title: Tables

snapshotChunkRows.description: Rows per chunk of a cdc table's snapshot, read as of an SCN and held in memory until the redo log catches up with it.
snapshotChunkRows.title: Snapshot chunk rows

chunkRows.description: Rows per query on a table with a primary key whose columns are of types the source orders by; each chunk ends at a resume point.
chunkRows.title: Chunk rows

batchBytes.description: Approximate bytes of values per Arrow batch.
batchBytes.title: Batch bytes

maxConnections.description: The most connections a read holds, as many as it has lanes up to this. A cdc read's LogMiner session holds one of them.
maxConnections.title: Max connections
